brand.name: NUVEX
brand.description: Wholesale manufacturer and exporter of custom branded apparel. B2B only.

hero.headline: NUVEX
hero.body: Custom branded apparel. Wholesale only. We manufacture hoodies, polos, sweatshirts and caps with your logo — for corporates, events, hotels and distributors.

products.name: Hoodie
products.desc: Cotton fleece pullover and zip hoodies. 300–400 GSM. Custom logo embroidery and screen print.

products.name: Polo T-Shirt
products.desc: Premium pique polo for corporates, hotels and uniforms. Logo on chest or sleeve.

products.name: Sweatshirt
products.desc: Crew-neck fleece sweatshirts for teams, events and institutions. Pantone colour matching.

products.name: Cap
products.desc: Structured and unstructured caps with embroidered or printed logo. 6-panel and 5-panel.

methods.name: Screen Printing
methods.desc: High-opacity ink directly on fabric. Best for bold logos and large chest prints. Up to 8 colours.

methods.name: Embroidery
methods.desc: Thread stitched into fabric. Premium finish, lasting quality. Perfect for chest, sleeve and cap logos.

methods.name: Heat Transfer
methods.desc: Photographic-quality prints for complex gradients and full-colour artwork. Front, back, sleeve.

steps: Share your logo file (AI / PNG / PDF)
We send artwork proof for approval

reasons.title: B2B Only
reasons.desc: We work exclusively with businesses. No retail, no D2C. Serious buyers get serious pricing.

reasons.title: MOQ from 50
reasons.desc: Start small, scale fast. Minimum 50 pieces per design — low enough to test, low enough to reorder.

reasons.title: Export Ready
reasons.desc: We supply to UAE, UK, Australia and beyond. Every order packed and documented for international shipment.

reasons.title: Fast Turnaround
reasons.desc: 12–14 working days from artwork approval to dispatch. Faster than most factories. Reliable every time.

reasons.title: Full Custom
reasons.desc: Your logo, your colours, your labels. Embroidery, screen print, heat transfer. Front, back, sleeves.

reasons.title: Direct Response
reasons.desc: Reply within 2 hours. WhatsApp-first communication. No waiting, no middlemen, straight answers.
